chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the man who shaves his head in Mecca, he said: 'He returns the hair to Mina.'
ai.seo_question: What should a pilgrim do with their shaved hair during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the ritual disposal of hair shaved in Mecca, directing it to be taken to Mina. This practice underscores the sanctity of the body parts shed during the state of *Ihram* and links the physical act of shaving to the specific geography of the Hajj rites, ensuring the hair is treated with respect in the vicinity of the sacrificial area.
